title: In the Beauty of Holiness
lyrics_original: In the beauty of holiness
We see You Son of righteousness
So we bring all that we possess
To lay at Your feet
In the place where Your glory shines
Jesus lover of all mankind
You have drawn us with love sublime
To make us complete.
So I pause at Your gates once more
As my heart and my spirit soar
And I wish I could love You more
My God and my King.
Is there tribute that I could bring
Was there ever a song to sing
That could ever express, my King
The work that You've done
Could I ever conceive of this
All the depths and the heights and breadth
Of the riches I now possess
Because of Your love.
So I pause at Your gates once more
As my heart and my spirit soar
And I wish I could love You more
My God and my King.
So I pause at Your gates once more
As my heart and my spirit soar
And I wish I could love You more
My God and my King.

bible_verses.english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in the beauty of holiness.
Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your reasonable service.
Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for drawing me into Your presence with such infinite love. As I stand in awe of Your holiness today, I lay all that I am at Your feet. Cleanse my heart and let Your glory shine brightly through my life. Teach me to love You more fully, and grant me a spirit of grateful worship that honors You in all I do. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for drawing me into Your presence with such infinite love. As I stand in awe of Your holiness today, I lay all that I am at Your feet. Cleanse my heart and let Your glory shine brightly through my life. Teach me to love You more fully, and grant me a spirit of grateful worship that honors You in all I do. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: True worship begins when we catch a glimpse of the majesty and purity of Jesus, the Son of Righteousness. In His presence, we are not driven by duty, but drawn by a love so sublime that giving Him our all becomes our highest joy. As we pause at His gates today, let us bring our lives as a living sacrifice, resting in the beauty of His holiness. May our hearts be filled with a gentle longing to love Him more deeply each day.
